en: Psalms 107

p.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: 107:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 2  Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

en: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
u.src: 2  Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

p.src: 3  and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

en: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
u.src: 3  and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

p.src: 4  They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

en: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
u.src: 4  They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

p.src: 5  Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
u.src: 5  Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

p.src: 6  Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
u.src: 6  Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

p.src: 7  He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

en: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
u.src: 7  He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

p.src: 8  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
u.src: 8  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

p.src: 9  For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

en: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
u.src: 9  For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

p.src: 10  Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

en: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
u.src: 10  Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

p.src: 11  because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

en: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
u.src: 11  because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

en: 107:11 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 12  Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
u.src: 12  Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

p.src: 13  Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
u.src: 13  Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

p.src: 14  He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
u.src: 14  He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

p.src: 15  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
u.src: 15  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

p.src: 16  For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

en: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
u.src: 16  For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

p.src: 17  Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

en: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
u.src: 17  Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

p.src: 18  Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

en: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
u.src: 18  Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

p.src: 19  Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
u.src: 19  Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

p.src: 20  He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

en: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
u.src: 20  He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

p.src: 21  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
u.src: 21  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

p.src: 22  Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

en: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
u.src: 22  Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

p.src: 23  Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

en: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
u.src: 23  Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

p.src: 24  these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

en: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
u.src: 24  these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

p.src: 25  For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

en: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
u.src: 25  For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

p.src: 26  They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

en: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
u.src: 26  They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

p.src: 27  They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

en: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
u.src: 27  They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

p.src: 28  Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
u.src: 28  Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

p.src: 29  He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

en: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
u.src: 29  He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

p.src: 30  Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

en: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
u.src: 30  Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

p.src: 31  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
u.src: 31  Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

p.src: 32  Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

en: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
u.src: 32  Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

p.src: 33  He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

en: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
u.src: 33  He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

p.src: 34  and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

en: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
u.src: 34  and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

p.src: 35  He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

en: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
u.src: 35  He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

p.src: 36  There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

en: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
u.src: 36  There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

p.src: 37  sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

en: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
u.src: 37  sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

p.src: 38  He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

en: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
u.src: 38  He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

p.src: 39  Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

en: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
u.src: 39  Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

p.src: 40  He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

en: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
u.src: 40  He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

p.src: 41  Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

en: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
u.src: 41  Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

p.src: 42  The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

en: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
u.src: 42  The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

p.src: 43  Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

en: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
u.src: 43  Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
